preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(n == int(n) and 1 <= n <= 100 for n in [int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2]])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the sequence length n is an integer between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(all(a_i == int(a_i) and 0 <= a_i <= 10**9 for a_i in line.split()) for line in stdin.splitlines()[2::2])
preconditions.description: Each element a_i in the sequence is an integer between 0 and 10^9 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout_line == str(min_possible_max) for stdout_line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is the minimal possible maximum value in the sequence after any number of operations.

postconditions.expression: min_possible_max == min(max(a) for a in possible_sequences)
postconditions.description: The minimal possible maximum value is the smallest maximum value achievable across all possible sequences after any number of operations.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= min_possible_max <= max(original_sequence) for min_possible_max in [int(line) for line in stdout.splitlines()])
postconditions.description: The minimal possible maximum value is between 0 and the original maximum value in the sequence.
